info.description:
The HTTP API of a Tond server: everything the dashboard and the `tond` CLI do.

**Versioning.** Everything is under `/api/v1` (WebSockets included). Additive changes (new endpoints, new optional fields, new error codes) happen within v1; anything else gets a new version. `/health` and `/metrics` stay at the root.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with an API token (scoped; see `x-tond-scopes` on each operation, and `GET /api/v1/tokens/catalog`). The dashboard uses the `__Host-tond_session` cookie plus the `X-Tond-CSRF` header on mutations. On the server itself the root-only Unix socket (`/opt/tond/data/tond.sock`) needs no credentials and holds every scope. WebSockets also accept `?token=<token>`.

**Responses.** Every JSON response is an envelope: `{"success": true, "data": …}` or `{"success": false, "data": null, "error": {"code", "message", "hint", "field"}}`. Switch on `error.code` (see the ErrorCode schema: each code has a fixed HTTP status and `tond` CLI exit code); `message` is for humans and may change.

**Retries.** Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (see the parameter); replays return the stored response.

**Rate limits.** Operations marked with a 429 response share a per-client token bucket; the 429 carries `Retry-After`.
